pos.productNotInDatabase: No product with this code exists in the database. Register it in Admin or try another code.
pos.apiInsufficientStock: Insufficient stock for product {productId}: need {need}, have {have}
pos.help: F2 dry · F4 pay · arrows cart · +/- qty · Del remove · Esc clear

admin.title: Admin
admin.name: Name
admin.barcodeHint: Leave blank to assign an automatic code. Manual codes must be unique and use letters, digits, dot, underscore, or hyphen only.
admin.taxRatePercentHint: 0 = none or not set yet. Examples for Argentina: 21 (general), 10.5 (reduced). Used per product when the POS does not send a single global tax.
admin.deletePermanentConfirm: Permanently delete “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
admin.removeAllDialogAlertBody: You are about to deactivate all products that are still active in the database.
admin.removeAllDialogBody: Deactivated products disappear from the point of sale until you reactivate them individually or import your catalog again. There is no automatic undo from this screen. Continue only if you understand the scope and truly need this.
admin.inventoryHint: Set on-hand quantity and optional low-stock alert level. Changes are saved per row to limit server updates.

dashboard.title: Business overview
dashboard.customInvalid: Choose a start and end date for the custom period.
dashboard.kpiGrossProfitHint: Pre-tax sales minus units sold × base cost. Lines with no base cost subtract nothing.
dashboard.chartRevenueHint: Bars per period: POS and web for the selected range.
dashboard.noBuckets: No sales recorded in this period.
dashboard.noRankings: No line-level sales in this period.
dashboard.footerRange: Data from {start} to {end} (end is exclusive on the server).
dashboard.resetSalesDialogAlertBody: This deletes every POS ticket and every web order. Products, users, and vendor orders are not removed.
dashboard.resetSalesDialogBody: Use only after tests or in a demo environment. In production you would lose real sales history and traceability. There is no undo.
dashboard.resetSalesRestoreInventory: Restore inventory (add sold quantities back to stock)
dashboard.resetSalesRestoreInventoryHint: If left unchecked, current stock is unchanged—useful when you want inventory to stay as-is after testing.
dashboard.resetSalesSuccess: Done: removed {pos} POS tickets and {web} web orders.
dashboard.resetSalesSuccessInventoryOn: Quantities were added back to inventory.
dashboard.resetSalesDisabled: This action is disabled on this server. Set ALLOW_RESET_SALES=true in the API environment (e.g. backend/.env) and restart the API.

printer.title: Receipt printer
printer.intro: Customize ticket layout (header, footer, taxes, feed before cut). Logo printing needs ESC/POS mode on the server (PRINTER_PREFER_ESCPOS).
printer.storeNameHint: Shown centered; leave as configured on the server if you use the default from the environment.
printer.greetingHint: Optional short line after the store name.
printer.feedLinesHint: Extra paper feed so the auto-cutter grabs cleanly (0–30).
printer.logoHint: PNG or JPEG; sent only when the API uses python-escpos (PRINTER_PREFER_ESCPOS=true). Max ~180 KB.
